provenance.notes: Captured from saved classifier run 36341 (auction_lot 17217, model null, 2026-11-03T19:54:09.133Z). Production rationale: This is a single whisky Bottle, not an out-of-scope product. No inspected local candidate represents it. The available web snippets concern other Jack’s Pirate Orkney releases and do not resolve the exact bottle’s cask and strength, so there is not enough support to match or create an exact Bottle. The run predates reading Scotch Whisky Auctions lot pages (#1609), so the evidence pack adds the lot page text. Expected outcome checked against the lot page and photo on 2026-11-09, in a random sample of the 185th auction's no_match reviews. This case adds a reviewed transcription of the lot's first photo at full size, in the shape production's label reading takes; no extractor ran on this lot.

expected.summary: Create Jack Wiebers' Jack's Pirate Whisky Orkney 9-year-old, cask 108, 290 bottles, 59.5%. The title and the label photo both say 9 years; the label prints cask No. 108, only 290 bottles, 70cl and 59.5%. The lot page's facts (16 years, cask 421, 58%, 252 bottles, bottled 2018) describe another Jack's Pirate bottling, so the photo settles it. A published review lists cask 108 as a 9-year-old bottled 2019 at 59.5%.
